beschreibung: Germany U21 squad update | Three players earn late call-ups following injury withdrawals – Germany U21 head coach Antonio Di Salvo has been forced into three late squad changes ahead of the upcoming November 2026 internationals against Belgium and Croatia.

Niclas Füllkrug credits Werder Bremen medical staff for helping him rediscover form – peaking at Germany's Tuesday press conference, Niclas Füllkrug reflected on his injury-plagued spells abroad and explained how familiar surroundings, improved fitness, and the support of his Werder Bremen teammates have helped him rediscover his best form.
